title: Blood Gourds
subtitle: Vessels raised by rite
text: At Degree 3 the Rite of the Pallid Vessel wakes a Dried Gourd on a Lesser Working floor into a White Blood Gourd that holds its maker's blood. At Degree 4 the Rite of the Crimson Vessel steeps the white gourd with an amethyst shard on a Greater Working floor until it flushes red. At Degree 5 the Rite of the Ashen Vessel takes the red gourd and a ghast tear through fire, and the black gourd that comes out holds the most blood of the three.
